name: Grouped vs Interleaved Macro Distribution
definition: A classification of macro distribution where a node's macros are either a spatially adjacent subset of the data set (grouped) or an interleaved/random subset (interleaved or random).
summary: Grouped vs Interleaved Macro Distribution classifies how voxel blocks are assigned to nodes, distinguishing spatially contiguous grouping from scattered interleaving to balance cache coherence against communication overhead.
